mapper.select: SELECT distinct ua.id, ua.url, ua.is_pattern, ua.methods as methodStr, group_concat(mauat.target separator ',') as targetsStr FROM mp_auth_url_ac ua left join mp_auth_url_ac_target mauat on ua.id = mauat.urlac_id where ua.id = #{id} group by ua.id;

SELECT distinct ua.id, ua.url, ua.is_pattern, ua.methods as methodStr, group_concat(mauat.target separator ',') as targetsStr FROM mp_auth_url_ac ua left join mp_auth_url_ac_target mauat on ua.id = mauat.urlac_id where ua.is_pattern = 0 group by ua.id

SELECT distinct ua.id, ua.url, ua.is_pattern, ua.methods as methodStr, group_concat(mauat.target separator ',') as targetsStr FROM mp_auth_url_ac ua left join mp_auth_url_ac_target mauat on ua.id = mauat.urlac_id where ua.is_pattern = 1 group by ua.id

SELECT distinct ua.id, ua.url, ua.is_pattern, ua.methods as methodStr, group_concat(mauat.target separator ',') as targetsStr FROM mp_auth_url_ac ua left join mp_auth_url_ac_target mauat on ua.id = mauat.urlac_id
ua.url like
CONCAT(#{url}, '%')
group by ua.id

SELECT distinct ua.id, ua.url, ua.is_pattern, ua.methods as methodStr, group_concat(mauat.target separator ',') as targetsStr FROM mp_auth_url_ac ua left join mp_auth_url_ac_target mauat on ua.id = mauat.urlac_id
and mauat.target in
#{targetId}
group by ua.id
